dataset.name: LeanDojo Benchmark 4
dataset.license: mathlib4 is Apache-2.0; LeanDojo Benchmark 4 redistributes it under CC-BY-4.0
dataset.train_only_filter: Items are built exclusively from random/train.json. steps.jsonl covers all splits and is used only as a metadata index for the sealed-exclusion test, filtered on split == 'train'. The sealed pools (novel_premises/{val,test}.json, random/{val,test}.json) are never opened; arena.environments.rewrite_direction.assert_source_permitted raises on them.

generator.determinism: item_id = sha256(generator_version|proof_id|step_index|premise|arm); option order is drawn from Random(seed|item_id). The same seed reproduces byte-identical rendered items.
generator.item_population_rule: One item per rewrite tactic, built from the FIRST bracket element. Only the first element acts on the recorded state_before; later elements act on intermediate states LeanDojo does not record, so splitting them out would produce items whose question is not answerable from what is shown. Mixed-direction brackets are therefore neither excluded nor split: each contributes exactly one item, labelled by its first element.
generator.state_after_withheld: Items show state_before only. Showing state_after would make the task a diff and would reintroduce the 'the goal grew, so it was reversed' shortcut.

direction_distribution.prior_claim_note: The 36.9% reverse estimate did NOT reproduce. Measured reverse rate is 19.42% per rewrite element and 25.12% per tactic (first element). The binary is therefore NOT naturally balanced and must be balanced explicitly.

items.control_rationale: Every lemma contributes equally many forward and reverse items, so every lemma-constant feature (name, name n-grams, name affixes, the two sides' lengths and their ratio, side similarity) is uninformative by construction.

axes: side similarity (how much vocabulary the two sides share)
decisiveness (how strongly one side's distinctive vocabulary dominates the target)
distractor equalities in the local context
difficulty_ladder.scoring: additive 0-2 per axis, total 0-10; bin edges L1<=2, L2<=4, L3>4
difficulty_ladder.L0_arm: Explicit-positive control: the item restates the decisive relation outright ('the rewritten subterm is an instance of Side A/B, the side that occurs in the goal'). Solvable by construction, so it is EXCLUDED from the shortcut gate and exists only as a floor check that a solver can read the format.

notes.not_a_rewrite_tactic: the step is not a rewrite at all; the dominant term
notes.premise_signature_unavailable: the tracer resolved a name that corpus.jsonl does not carry a signature for (mostly core Lean / Batteries declarations); without the equation the item cannot be posed
notes.premise_not_resolved: the first bracket element is a local hypothesis or an unannotated term, so no library equation identifies it
notes.no_top_level_equation: the premise's type does not end in a top-level = or IFF, or carries two top-level occurrences of the same non-associative relation
notes.arrow_token_in_rendered_text: the state or statement itself contains an arrow token; refused so that the no-arrow leakage invariant stays an exact assertion
notes.leakage_guard_tripped: the assembled item failed leakage_violations() and was dropped by the generator's last line of defence

protocol.source: LeanDojo random/train.json only (sealed pools never read)
protocol.balancing: every lemma contributes equally many forward and reverse items, applied independently on each side of the file split
protocol.l0_explicit_positive_arm: excluded from the gate (solvable by construction)

responsible_features: lemma_name_char_ngram_logistic 0.6748 - pure name recall, no state read
expression_length_ratio 0.6261 - a lemma constant, not a state fact
